subtitle: The vanilla Fire Torch without normal burn-time depletion.
description: A focused quality-of-life mod for the vanilla Fire Torch, keeping it usable without normal burn-time depletion.
features: Works with the vanilla Fire Torch instead of adding a replacement item.
Removes the need to replace a torch because its normal burn time has run out.
The change is focused on torch behavior and does not require a separate UI.

faq.question: Does the mod add a new torch item?
faq.answer: No. It changes the behavior of the vanilla Fire Torch.

faq.question: Does each split-screen player need a separate setting?
faq.answer: No. This is a runtime behavior change to the world item.

faq.question: Is a release history included on the page?
faq.answer: Not yet. The changelog is intentionally empty until verified release notes are curated.
